english.title: Fail notify local authority within 48 hours of water cut off to inhabited house
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a water undertaker, failed, without reasonable excuse, to serve notice with respect to disconnection of water supply to an inhabited house at **(..SPECIFY ADDRESS..) on **(..SPECIFY LOCAL AUTHORITY..), the local authority in whose area the house was situated, as required by section 63(1) of the Water Industry Act 1991
english.legislation: Contrary to section 63(2) and (4) of the Water Industry Act 1991.
